brief: Body-driven short descending diagonal cut. Rear-leg load, hips and shoulder coil; pressure transfers to flexed front knee, torso inclines, both hands accelerate a rigid katana; overshoot settles below execution; recover along controlled arc to original guard. Feet remain planted; no scene/root translation.
intent: A compact deliberate two-handed descending cut threatening upper torso through waist, not a footward idle sword swing. No new hitboxes/damage.
support: Same two floor contacts, heel/toe and knee action allowed; pelvis and head move through space while segment lengths remain stable.
